title: Marpy's Music Disc Additions
description: A Datapack adding fan music discs obtainable just like vanilla discs!
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/614492cb699d306806d49cbd83890dc758fe9120.png)
Bored of getting the same old music discs from creepers?
Then this datapack is for you!

This Datapack comes with 6 NEW fanmade music discs and 3 backported music discs from the tricky trials update! I handpicked music discs coming from Steelman and Laudividni that give a nice pleasent feeling, that in my opinion, didn't stray too far from vanilla music discs.
